_help: Manual fixes for when the wiki is late or wrong. Edit on github.com, commit, and the site rebuilds in ~1 minute.
holdBackAfter: a number forces the site to never show past that episode (emergency spoiler brake). null = off.
confirmEpisodes: episode numbers to publish even though the wiki hasn't listed who left (e.g. no-elimination episode).
exits: { "Full Name": { "ep": 5, "finish": "5th Voted Out" } } to set or fix when someone left.
castaways: { "Full Name": { ...any field... } } to override wiki data for a castaway.
